data.narrative:
Gauss Fusion is a Series A–stage nuclear energy company founded by Milena Roveda, having raised €9M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers across public and private markets: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, Helion, Oklo, Fuse Energy, and X-Energy, all operating in frontier nuclear technology.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression anchored to the €9M total raised as a proxy base value and applied a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying a $18M valuation. Peer-Median analysis examined three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers: Valar Atomics at Series B ($6.0B), Nano Nuclear Energy at Seed ($808M), and Fuse Energy at Series A ($200M). The median of these three yields $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $15M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $413M. The wide dispersion—driven primarily by the peer-median method's exposure to Valar Atomics' outsized valuation—reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriate comparables for frontier nuclear. Stage-Progression alone suggests $18M; peer anchoring suggests substantially higher valuations. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-peer sample and whether later-stage peers (Series B) appropriately inform Series A pricing in this nascent sector.
